protected-area.definition: Areas designated for nature or landscape protection (SSSI, SAC, SPA, national park, nature reserve)

habitat.definition: Mapped habitats, vegetation communities, biotopes, priority habitat inventories

species-occurrence.definition: Records or ranges of species, species richness, biodiversity indicators

woodland.definition: Woodland, forest and tree cover inventories, ancient woodland

tree.definition: Individual trees, street trees, tree preservation orders

soil.definition: Soil types, soil properties, soil carbon

geology.definition: Bedrock and superficial geology, boreholes, faults, mineral resources

land-cover.definition: Land cover or land use classifications from imagery

land-use-plan.definition: Development plans, zoning, allocations, policy areas, green belt

land-ownership.definition: Land and property ownership, cadastral parcels, council-owned land, assets

brownfield.definition: Brownfield and contaminated land, derelict land registers

heritage-site.definition: Listed buildings, scheduled monuments, conservation areas, historic environment records, World Heritage

admin-boundary.definition: Administrative and electoral boundaries, wards, parishes, local authority areas

statistical-area.definition: Census and statistical geographies (output areas, LSOAs, data zones) and the statistics on them

maritime-boundary.definition: Territorial sea, EEZ, marine planning regions, offshore licensing boundaries

settlement.definition: Towns, villages, built-up areas, settlement boundaries

deprivation.definition: Deprivation, poverty, inequality and wellbeing indices

building.definition: Building footprints, building attributes, energy performance

road.definition: Road network, classifications, speed limits, road works, gritting routes

public-transport.definition: Bus routes and stops, public transport access

active-travel.definition: Cycle routes, footpaths, public rights of way, walking routes

parking.definition: Car parks, parking zones, permits, EV charging

port-airport.definition: Ports, harbours, airports and their limits

shipping.definition: Shipping lanes, vessel density, navigation features

river.definition: Rivers, streams, canals, lakes, catchments, water body status

flood-risk.definition: Flood zones, flood risk, flood defences, historic flooding

water-quality.definition: Water quality, bathing waters, pollution incidents, discharges

coastline.definition: Coastline, coastal change, erosion, shoreline management

marine-activity.definition: Fishing areas, aquaculture, marine licences, marine protected areas use

elevation.definition: Terrain and surface models, LiDAR, contours, hillshade

air-quality.definition: Air quality measurements, management areas, emissions

noise.definition: Noise mapping and noise action areas

natural-hazard.definition: Landslides, subsidence, earthquakes, radon, other natural hazards

agriculture.definition: Crops, agricultural land classification, farm schemes, livestock

power-line.definition: Electricity transmission and distribution lines, substations

pipeline.definition: Oil, gas, water or CO2 pipelines

oil-gas.definition: Oil and gas licences, fields, wells, platforms

offshore-wind-site.definition: Offshore wind leases, sites and cable routes

renewable-potential.definition: Wind, solar, heat or other renewable resource and opportunity areas

waste.definition: Waste sites, recycling points, bin collection

health-facility.definition: Hospitals, GP surgeries, pharmacies, care homes

health-indicator.definition: Health outcomes and indicators by area

community-facility.definition: Libraries, community centres, public toilets, council offices

greenspace.definition: Parks, open space, allotments, playgrounds, sports pitches

crime-safety.definition: Crime, policing areas, fire and rescue, emergency planning

business-economy.definition: Businesses, employment, economic activity, retail centres

housing.definition: Housing stock, tenure, housing need, HMOs

licensing.definition: Premises licences, taxis, street trading and other local licences

conflict-event.definition: Armed conflict and political violence events

military.definition: Military training areas, danger areas, defence estate
